title: Venture roundtable: post-ZIRP survival, secondaries, and why AI-first teams beat adding headcount
summary: Jason hosts a VC roundtable on secondaries, backlogged unicorns, and the shift from growth-at-all-costs to profitability. His own contributions: scaling a portfolio via buckets and pods, selling some shares along the way, and a closing point that automating a job function beats the pain of recruiting.

principles.text: Smart founders solve problems with automation instead of adding headcount; recruiting is slow and often wrong.
principles.quote: Smart founders are starting to realize I don't need to solve every problem by adding a body that once you realize the best way to solve a problem is automation, not recruiting people. Recruiting people is painful.
